GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight. ($2.05 favourite, 4th placegetter). Rider reported after beginning awkwardly, he settled further back than intended. He added he had anticipated racing in a one-off position throughout the event, however he was taken in and obliged to race on the rail throughout the event. He further added whilst he had some difficulty in obtaining clear running, the gelding responded to his riding only moderately in the straight.  A post-race vet exam - No abnormalities. Swab samples taken.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 800m improved around Yauson before crossing to settle outside the leader near the 600m.  When questioned regarding his riding through the middle stages and the reason for shifting out and leaving a trailing position behind race favourite, Rider stated that the gelding raced keenly throughout the event and passing the 1000m he felt the tempo of the race slackened and as a result was placed close to the heels of Yauson, and for this reason he shifted out and allowed Crocodile to stride forward before settling outside the leader near the 600m
